description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the New Jersey Statutes (N.J.S.A.) — New Jersey state law — by citation, plus its amendment history where the source lists one. "N.J.S.A. 2C:11-3" is murder; "39:4-50" is driving while intoxicated; "46:8-1" is a landlord-tenant statute. Returns the statutory text, a parsed amendment_history line when the section has been amended (empty for an original, unamended section), and says explicitly that a prior point-in-time version is not available through this source. Keyless. Use for "what does N.J.S.A. 39:4-50 say" or to check a citation a case or bill relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "2C:11-3" (murder), "39:4-50" (DWI), or "46:8-19" (security deposits). The part before the colon is the Title.

name: nj_statute_section
title: Nj Statute Section
